name: Founder's Bamboo Staff (Trúc Trượng)
lore: A plain staff of forest bamboo, worn pale at the grip, that Mạc Nhất Thoa carried on the road from before the Gate was founded (A289). It has been cut down and rebound three times, and every head of the Gate has walked a year of the road with it. Nhậm Bình Sinh left it to Úc Diệp Thanh in 1169.
build_use: The Gate's staff: Physical damage, evasion and steadiness for a fight that keeps moving.

name: One Straw Cape (Nhất Thoa Y)
lore: The founder's straw rain cape. The straw has gone silver and no longer sheds water, and nothing that falls on it is felt. Nhậm Bình Sinh left it to Phí Thoa Y in 1169.
build_use: Sustain and status resistance for a long road.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Guide's Lamp (Dẫn Lộ Đăng)
lore: A horn lantern with a wick of bamboo pith, kept by the Road Mother for the night crossings. The Night Rain Edict lit no lamps (A274), and the Gate has carried this one through the Tower's forest every night since, which the Tower has never forgiven and never forbidden.
build_use: A guide's utility piece: sight, evasion and a way out.

name: Salt-Carrier's Jacket (Bối Diêm Giáp)
lore: His father's carrying jacket from Thủ Lôi Bảo, padded at the shoulders for the salt and barley loads. It came out of the fort before Phượng Minh burned it in 1042 (V161).
build_use: Still walking at the end of a long fight: health, guard and regeneration.
made_by: his father, a porter of Thủ Lôi Bảo
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Pendant of the Pass (Quan Ải Ngọc Bội)
lore: A guide's jade token, the kind every Xuyên Lâm guide carries. This one was his brother Úc Từ Hành's, sent down from Đan Sơn Mạch in 1156 by a Tower officer who did not know whose it was.
build_use: The flash of the step and the crack of the staff.

name: Jade of the Road Mother (Lộ Mẫu Ngọc Bội)
lore: A green jade bead for every guide she has trained, strung on one cord. There are a hundred and twelve, and two are black, for the guides the road kept.
build_use: She outlasts: regeneration and a guard.
